note: Hooks of a real droid with the managed capture prefix, plus the probe's own ps view of that droid (kind droid/tui rows, alive and comm). Covers script runs, /new, a resume in a new process, Ctrl-C, SIGHUP and SIGTERM exits. A '<defunct>' comm is a zombie. Rows are copied from the research branch, except that the kernel boot id inside each Linux startTime is the nil UUID. Scanned for emails, home paths, API keys and tokens: none. Session ids are 8-character prefixes or S1/S2 relations.
clock: rows are in the order the probe listener or logger recorded them
